issues.description: manifest.yaml uses `software:` as the top-level key instead of `name:` as specified in code style rule 14. Additionally, the build system is declared as a nested `build: system: makefile` structure (lines 11-12) instead of the flat `build_system: makefile` field. The standard format requires: `name: cloud-utils` and `build_system: makefile`. This issue was identified in the previous audit and has NOT been fixed in this re-run.
issues.fix_suggestion:
Rename `software:` to `name:` at line 1, and flatten the build configuration from `build:
  system: makefile` to `build_system: makefile`. The remaining build sub-fields (configure_options, dependencies, cc, cxx) can be kept as top-level keys or moved to a `build_config:` section if the schema allows it.

issues.description: While R34 passes (the test_package does execute real binaries: growpart, write-mime-multipart, cloud-localds via --help), the tests only invoke `--help` which is a minimal smoke test. Consider adding more thorough functional tests that verify actual script behavior (e.g., test write-mime-multipart with actual input to verify MIME output, or test growpart with a mock disk image). This issue was identified in the previous audit and remains as a non-blocking suggestion.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add at least one functional test beyond `--help`. For example: `self.run("write-mime-multipart --help | grep -q 'usage'", env='conanrun')` or test actual script output with sample inputs.

summary: W4 Pre-PR Audit (re-run) for cloud-utils 0.33 — branch feat/cloud-utils-0.33, 13 changed files. cloud-utils is a pure shell/Python script package (no compilation) adapted to HarmonyOS PC (arm64). VERDICT: PASS (no P0/P1 issues). Previous audit fixes verification: (1) P1 CS5 — `url = "" # CI fills this` REMOVED from conanfile.py ✅ VERIFIED (no url attribute, no template placeholders found); (2) P2 CS13 — `description` → `patch_description` + `patch_type: "portability"` FIXED in conandata.yml ✅ VERIFIED (all 6 patch entries use patch_description and patch_type); (3) P2 CS16 — unused `import os` REMOVED from conanfile.py ✅ VERIFIED (only conan imports remain); (4) P2 CS16 — unused `import os` REMOVED from test_package/conanfile.py ✅ VERIFIED (only conan import remains). Deception detection (Section 1): All checks pass — R34 test_package executes real binaries (growpart, write-mime-multipart, cloud-localds via --help), no fake sha256 (64 valid hex chars: 338770d6...), no fake status, no empty #ifdef __OHOS__ stubs (not applicable), no pre-compiled binaries (no .so/.a/.o files), R40 deep adaptation N/A for script package. Recipe quality (Section 2): R39 source URL is official GitHub canonical/cloud-utils (HTTPS). R38 commands.json exists at software-level (archives/c/cloud-utils/commands.json) with type='tool', name='cloud-utils'. R26/R32 N/A for script package. R33 no bare env vars. R37 first-time version 0.33 (no suffix needed). Conan 2.x API used correctly (from conan import ConanFile, conan.tools.files, conan.tools.layout). Method order correct: export_sources → layout → source → build → package → package_info. package_type='application' correct for tool. package_info sets bindirs=['bin']. Remaining non-blocking issues: (1) P2 CS14 — manifest.yaml still uses `software:` instead of `name:` and `build: system:` instead of `build_system:` (not listed as a fix in this re-run, still present); (2) P3 R34 — test_package only uses --help (minimal but valid). Patches are properly formatted with 4-digit numbering, real diffs, and legitimate HarmonyOS adaptations (install command --mode=0644 → -m 0644, shebang fixes #!/bin/bash → #!/usr/bin/env bash, #!/usr/bin/python3 → #!/usr/bin/env python3). All 13 changed files verified on disk to match audit input.
